evidence: This is a 4x3 grid of flat sci-fi metal floor/ground tiles seen from above, with bevels, rivets, and recessed vents appropriate for terrain.

style.evidence: The metal plates have 5 distinct slate-blue tones plus a 4-step cyan light ramp. Bevels, rivets, seams, and recessed panels break up the surface so there are no large flat fills, though smooth metal is naturally slightly less speckled than cobblestone.
